import math

def gcd_of(a, b):
    while b != 0:
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

x, y, n = map(float, input().split())
ratio = x / y
min_diff = 1e9
if y <= n:
    num = int(x)
    den = int(y)
else:
    for i in range(int(n), 0, -1):
        denom = i
        val = denom * ratio
        if val - math.floor(val) <= 0.5:
            candidate = int(math.floor(val))
        else:
            candidate = int(math.floor(val)) + 1
        current_ratio = candidate / denom
        diff = abs(current_ratio - ratio)
        if diff <= min_diff:
            min_diff = diff
            num = candidate
            den = denom
g = gcd_of(num, den)
num //= g
den //= g
print(f"{num}/{den}")
